d:
A bitter family feud between former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister YS Jagan Mohan Reddy and his sister YS Sharmila has erupted once again, this time over the disputed Yelahanka Palace in Bengaluru.
On November 22, 2026, Andhra Pradesh Congress chief YS Sharmila and her mother YS Vijayamma were stopped by Bengaluru Police while attempting to visit the property. The police cited an interim court injunction restricting access to the bungalow.
